title: Best B2B store platforms for a catalog chatbot: Shopify, BigCommerce, WooCommerce and Magento

linkedin.post:
You are staring at four platforms and hoping one of them is the answer.

Shopify, BigCommerce, WooCommerce and Magento all look capable. The article says none of them is best on its own.

I answer from what the store hands me. So I check four things: specs in fields, buyer-specific prices, API access with change events, and a quote handoff.

Fix the foundation first, then let the catalog talk. Which of the four needs is weakest in your store today?
